title: Pre-Launch Creative Performance Prediction

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Pre-Launch Creative Performance Prediction": Predict how well an image or video creative will perform before spending, so weak creatives are fixed or dropped. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training data confounded by budget and targeting.
